correctness.rationale: Under e>=2k+1 and 1<=j<=e-k-1, explicit two- and three-generator offset sums show exactly the stated two or three gap intervals and certify no later gaps. Generator witnesses eliminate every lower gap from PF, leaving the claimed PF intervals. Counting these intervals gives F,g,type and defect, with boundary j=1 and empty upper-position range handled. The Apéry-set socle identifies last Betti number. The standalone standard-library checker independently verified 10857 parameter triples to e=48 and 530299 gaps; no finite-to-infinite inference was made.

value.rationale: Complete PF set and terminal Betti classification of a natural consecutive-deletion semigroup family for arbitrary multiplicity e>=2k+1 and deleted block length k>=3; for fixed e and embedding dimension e-k, deletion position realizes every possible type 1..e-k-1 exactly once. The exact defect detects the unique almost-symmetric position. These go beyond previously established F/genus and symmetry, supplying a natural structural invariant relevant to Sally-ring homological invariants.
